nodes.description: uint256 private totalTokens; total amount of minted tokens
mapping(uint256=>address) private tokenOwner; token id to owner
mapping(uint256=>address) private tokenApprovals; approved address per token
mapping(address=>uint256[]) private ownedTokens; owner token list
mapping(uint256=>uint256) private ownedTokensIndex
Modes public mode = Modes.LIVE; contract operating mode
address internal ceoAddress; privileged role
address internal cfoAddress; privileged role receiving withdrawals
address internal cooAddress; privileged role
address public newContractAddress; upgrade target
mapping(uint=>TokenModel) tokens; stores price, openTime, serial
mapping(string=>uint) idOfSerial; serial to token id
uint RISE_RATE = 110; price multiplier after trade
uint RISE_RATE_FAST = 150; price multiplier for cheap tokens
uint8 SALE_FEE_RATE = 2; platform fee percentage
uint CARVE_UP_INPUT = 0.01 ether; carve-up entry stake
uint[10] carveUpTokens; carve-up round participants
uint8 carverUpIndex; carve-up queue index
function totalSupply() public view returns uint256
function balanceOf(address _owner) public view returns uint256
function ownerOf(uint256 _tokenId) public view returns address
function approve(address _to, uint256 _tokenId) public onlyOwnerOf
function transfer(address _to, uint256 _tokenId) public onlyOwnerOf
function takeOwnership(uint256 _tokenId) public; claims approved token
function _mint(address _to, uint256 _tokenId) internal
function _burn(uint256 _tokenId) onlyOwnerOf internal
internal transfer routine clearing approval and moving ownership
private clearApproval(address _owner, uint256 _tokenId)
private addToken(address _to, uint256 _tokenId); mints into owner list
private removeToken(address _from, uint256 _tokenId); burns from owner list
internal view isApprovedFor(address _owner, uint256 _tokenId)
external setNewAddress(address _v2Address) onlyCEO
constructor CommonEth() sets ceoAddress = msg.sender
public stopLive() onlyCOO sets mode to TEST
public startLive() onlyCOO sets mode to LIVE
public setCEO(address _newCEO) onlyCEO; privileged role change
public setCFO(address _newCFO) onlyCEO; privileged role change
public setCOO(address _newCOO) onlyCEO; privileged role change
payable joinCarveUpTen(uint _tokenId) onlyLiveMode onlyOwnerOf; pays ETH to 9 owners
payable buy(uint _id) onlyLiveMode; pays ETH to owner and all holders, reprices token
public createByCOO(string serial, uint price, uint openTime) onlyCOO
public updateUnsold(string serial, uint _price, uint _openTime) onlyCOO
private __createNewToken(...) returns TokenModel; mints new token
public withdrawContractEther(uint withdrawAmount) onlyCFO; sends ETH to cfo
public view withdrawAbleEther() onlyCFO; computes withdrawable balance
function() external payable; accepts plain ETH
modifier onlyOwnerOf(uint256 _tokenId); requires ownerOf == msg.sender
modifier onlyCEO(); requires msg.sender == ceoAddress
modifier onlyLiveMode(); requires LIVE mode or staff msg.sender
msg.sender; caller-controlled identity used for auth and payouts
now / block.timestamp; miner-influenced time used in checks and winner selection
ownerOf(_id).transfer(...) and loop ownerOf(i).transfer(bonus) raw ETH sends in buy
ownerOf(carveUpTokens[j]).transfer(bonus) raw ETH sends to 9 owners in joinCarveUpTen
cfoAddress.transfer(withdrawAmount) raw ETH send in withdrawContractEther
token.price * RISE_RATE(_FAST) / 100 and token.price * SALE_FEE_RATE arithmetic in buy
winner index derived from now digits ((now%10)+(now/10%10)+...) % 10 in joinCarveUpTen
totalTokens.sub(1) and balance/list index arithmetic in removeToken
this.balance - carverUpIndex * CARVE_UP_INPUT and balance comparison in withdrawContractEther
carverUpIndex % 10 == 9 increment/reset arithmetic in joinCarveUpTen
parameter _tokenId of joinCarveUpTen / onlyOwnerOf
parameter _id of buy
parameter _to of transfer/approve
parameter _from of clearApprovalAndTransfer / removeToken
parameter withdrawAmount of withdrawContractEther
parameter _newCEO of setCEO
parameter _v2Address of setNewAddress
parameter serial of createByCOO / updateUnsold
local TokenModel storage token = tokens[_id] in buy
local uint bonus in buy holder distribution
local loop index uint i in buy
local uint bonus = CARVE_UP_INPUT * 110 / 100 in joinCarveUpTen
local loop index uint8 j in joinCarveUpTen
local uint theLoserIndex computed from now in joinCarveUpTen
local uint256 balance = this.balance in withdrawContractEther
local uint256 length = balanceOf(_to) in addToken
local address owner in ownerOf/approve
local TokenModel memory s in __createNewToken
local uint256 tokenIndex in removeToken

edges.reason: constructor assigns ceoAddress = msg.sender, giving the deployer full privileged control
onlyCEO compares untrusted msg.sender against ceoAddress
onlyOwnerOf requires ownerOf(_tokenId) == msg.sender
onlyLiveMode whitelists msg.sender as potential staff
joinCarveUpTen trusts msg.sender as token owner and stake payer
buy transfers token ownership and payouts relative to msg.sender
NFToken constructor sets CFO/COO to msg.sender
block.timestamp directly determines the carve-up loser and payout distribution
block.timestamp used for openTime < now gate and lastTime update in buy
createByCOO stores now as createTime and lastTime
winner index is derived from decimal digits of now, manipulable by miners
onlyOwnerOf gates entry to joinCarveUpTen
onlyOwnerOf gates entry to transfer
onlyOwnerOf gates entry to _burn
onlyCEO gates the upgrade address change
onlyCEO gates CEO reassignment
onlyLiveMode gates joinCarveUpTen
onlyLiveMode gates buy
buy performs raw ETH transfer to the previous owner and to every other holder
joinCarveUpTen performs raw ETH transfers to nine token owners
withdrawContractEther performs a raw ETH transfer to cfoAddress
token price is recomputed with multiplication by RISE_RATE/RISE_RATE_FAST and division by 100
removeToken performs balanceOf(_from).sub(1) and totalTokens.sub(1) index arithmetic
withdrawable balance computed as this.balance - carverUpIndex * CARVE_UP_INPUT
joinCarveUpTen computes the losing index from block.timestamp
carverUpIndex is incremented and reset modulo 10 during carve-up rounds
the raw ETH transfer in buy transfers control to a token owner who can re-enter buy or other payable functions
the raw ETH transfer in joinCarveUpTen transfers control to a token owner who can re-enter the carve-up
the raw ETH transfer to cfoAddress can invoke a contract fallback that re-enters withdrawContractEther
timestamp-derived winner selection decides who receives ETH, giving an attacker influence over payouts and re-entry timing
buy indexes the tokens mapping with the caller supplied _id
buy reads and writes the stored TokenModel for _id
the recomputed price is written back to tokens[_id].price
joinCarveUpTen writes the supplied _tokenId into carveUpTokens
the loop index j reads carveUpTokens entries for payout
_from flows into clearApprovalAndTransfer as the source owner
_to is the recipient passed to transfer and clearApprovalAndTransfer
withdrawAmount is compared against the computed contract balance
clearApprovalAndTransfer invokes clearApproval
clearApprovalAndTransfer invokes removeToken
clearApprovalAndTransfer invokes addToken
_mint invokes addToken to register the new owner
_burn invokes clearApproval
_burn invokes removeToken
joinCarveUpTen queries ownerOf to pay each participant
buy queries ownerOf for payouts and for the ownership transfer
__createNewToken invokes _mint for the new token id
buy finalizes the sale by calling clearApprovalAndTransfer
takeOwnership calls clearApprovalAndTransfer after approval check

normalization_plan.reason: _tokenId parameter is only meaningful inside joinCarveUpTen ownership gating
_id parameter is only used to index tokens inside buy
_to parameter is the recipient consumed by transfer
_from parameter is consumed by clearApprovalAndTransfer ownership logic
withdrawAmount parameter is consumed by withdrawContractEther payout
_newCEO parameter is consumed by setCEO privileged write
_v2Address parameter is consumed by setNewAddress upgrade write
serial parameter is consumed by createByCOO token creation
local TokenModel storage token is scoped to buy
local bonus is computed and paid inside buy
local loop index i drives the payout loop in buy
local bonus is computed and paid inside joinCarveUpTen
local loop index j drives the payout loop in joinCarveUpTen
local theLoserIndex is derived from timestamp and used only in joinCarveUpTen
local balance is read only to authorize the withdrawal in withdrawContractEther
local length is the insertion index computed inside addToken
local owner is the storage read validation inside ownerOf
local TokenModel memory s is assembled and stored inside __createNewToken
local tokenIndex is used for swap-and-pop removal inside removeToken
